title: Scaling ramp hang investigation, quarantine safeguard, and tenant hotfix
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Several customers reported intermittent capacity shortfalls during sustained bursts despite the autoscaler signaling scale-ups. Investigation revealed a provisioning "hang" in the cloud node provisioning pipeline: requests were accepted but remained in a pending state (cloud provider queue) beyond our headroom window, preventing the reserved-pool headroom from being replenished and triggering tenant-facing burst throttles. This issue manifested as degraded latency and error rate spikes for bursty tenants that rely on reserved headroom and burst credits.

This ticket covers the end-to-end work: reproduce, root-cause analysis, emergency mitigation (hotfix and communications), long-term fix (quarantine safeguard + allocator changes), observability additions, and postmortem action items.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a dedicated tenant with reserved pool configured and enabled burst policy
2) Drive a sustained increase to request-per-second above baseline to exhaust local headroom
3) Simulate accelerated autoscaler decisions that request N new nodes from cloud provider
4) Inject artificial delay in cloud node provisioning (>= 90s) and observe allocator lease state and reserved pool headroom metric
5) Observe request shedding / 429s for tenant burst requests even though autoscaler signaled +nodes
6) Reproduce locally using provisioning simulator in staging (script: staging/tools/provision_sim.sh)
Note: repro uses the new provisioning_pulse test harness added for this work
root_cause: When the NodeProvisioner issues instance requests, transient rate-limiting and internal cloud queuing caused request state to stay in "pending" for longer than our autoscaler horizon. The allocator kept leases reserved for those pending nodes without moving them to fallback capacity, so reserved headroom stayed negative. The autoscaler assumed the lease would materialize and did not trigger emergency fallback routing. There was no circuit to quarantine long-pending leases and either 1) reattempt provisioning with a different shape/region, or 2) release the lease and route requests to cold/on-demand pools immediately. Additionally, existing telemetry lacked a clear provisioning_pulse and a histogram of pending durations, so the condition was blind to SRE dashboards until customer reports.
mitigations: Prod emergency hotfix (rolled out 2026-02-20): allocator change to detect >45s pending provisioning and automatically trigger immediate fallback routing to compatible cold pools while leaving a pending mark on the lease (soft-reserve). This reduced 429s by 92% for affected tenants in the incident window.
Short term: increased alerting thresholds on provision_pending_count and added an alert playbook (pager duty) to notify SRE at 30s+ pending average per region.
Long term: implement lease quarantine policy (see implementation notes) and retry/backoff strategy with alternative instance shapes and cross-AZ fallback within 10s of pending threshold breach.
Added client-side retry guidance for SDKs to smooth burst patterns per runtime docs.
Customer comms: Sent incident summary and temporary mitigation details to affected accounts and Customer Success on 2026-02-21 (templates/incident/ENG-947620-email.md).
implementation_notes: Quarantine lease policy: if provision state == 'pending' && pending_duration > pending_threshold (config: 45s), mark lease as 'quarantined' and decrement reserved_headroom metric. Quarantined leases no longer block fallback admission; an async reconciler will attempt alternate provisioning targets with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts.
Allocator changes: separate 'soft-reserve' (holds billing/capacity intent) from hard resource accounting. Soft-reserves can be forcibly demoted to free if quarantined to allow fallback to cold pools.
New metrics: provisioning_pulse (gauge per region), pending_provision_duration_histogram, quarantined_lease_count, soft_reserve_demotions_total.
Added integration test: provisioning_pulse_sim that simulates cloud queue responses; runs in CI gating for autoscaler core package.
Migration: feature flag 'allocator_quarantine_v1' used to stage rollout; toggled on 2026-02-22 for region us-west-2, monitored for 48h before global enable.
Runbook update: sources/runbooks/dedicated-autoscaler.md now includes steps to force-demote quarantined leases and manual cross-AZ reprovisioning.
Backward-compat: lease serialization unchanged; quarantine state is a new enum value with default safe behavior for older controllers (no-op).
postmortem_action_items: A1: Expand staging provisioning simulator to cover cloud provider 'soft-queue' behavior and add to nightly stress tests (owner: Diego Rivera, due 2026-03-15).
A2: Harden autoscaler test harness to fail-on-unreconciled-leases after 30s in CI for any region (owner: Priya Anand, due 2026-03-08).
A3: Finalize alternate-shape auto-fallback rollout for burst scenarios (owner: SRE team, due 2026-03-25).
A4: Create a customer-facing postmortem for the two largest affected customers and add them to advisory registry for proactive scaling guidance (owner: Customer Success, due 2026-03-12).
A5: Add an SLA note and a test in upgrade matrices to ensure node-provisioner and allocator version compatibility (owner: Platform, due 2026-04-01).
comments: 2026-02-18 Maya Chen: Triage - multiple customer tickets referencing 429s during burst. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler misprediction. Created this ticket to coordinate investigation with SRE and NodeProvisioner teams.

2026-02-19 Diego Rivera: Reproduced in staging using provision_sim.sh. Observed pending durations up to 120s under simulated provider throttling; allocator kept soft-reserves active so headroom did not recover. Captured flame graphs and tracing (link in links).

2026-02-20 Diego Rivera: Hotfix rolled to us-west-2: allocator now treats >45s pending as eligible for immediate fallback. Early metrics show 92% reduction in burst 429s for affected tenants. Pager duty silence requested; continuing rollout plan.
2026-02-21 Priya Anand: QA report - integration tests added; one flaky test fixed by increasing provision_sim timeouts. Manual verification with AcmeCommerce confirmed reduced latency tails.
2026-02-22 SRE Lead (Omar Patel): Feature flag 'allocator_quarantine_v1' enabled globally after 48h stable telemetry. No regression in cost metrics beyond expected fallback delta.

2026-03-01 Product (Lena Kovacs): Customer comms draft reviewed. Recommended adding post-change guidance to the console on 'burst readiness' and reservation health. Filed follow-up PM ticket to add UI indicator.
2026-03-05 Diego Rivera: Backfilled metrics and set up alert thresholds. Added Grafana dashboards and a synthetic canary that exercises provisioning fallbacks every 6h.
2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Postmortem completed and action items assigned. Closing ticket after verification that quarantined lease reconciler handled 97% of cases and CI tests are passing.
